name: codex-remote
description: Restricted Codex phone pairing for Ridan Korea audit sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Restricted phone pairing for read-only audits
interface.longDescription: Restricted profile for pairing the ChatGPT phone app with Codex CLI on a dedicated audit account. The default agent surface contains only relay status and an explicitly requested QR pairing action. Pairing enables persistent native remote access. Administrative enable/disable and paired-device management tools are hidden by default and require an operator environment opt-in. Terminal Extensions are separately disabled by default. This plugin does not itself sandbox filesystem access: configure Codex read-only mode and enforce project/secret separation with Linux permissions. Node.js 24+ and a compatible native Codex remote-control interface are required. Community project based on Cheaux/codex-remote; not maintained or endorsed by OpenAI.
capabilities: Request an explicitly authorized phone pairing QR
defaultPrompt: Show the QR for remote session pairing.
Check the native remote relay status.
